newsitem.title: USA: Kodak to end pact with Burma distributor.
newsitem.headline: Kodak to end pact with Burma distributor.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said Monday it plans to end its relationship with an independent distributor in Burma that it did not name.

Kodak spokesman Paul Allen said the company will discontinue the relationship with the distributor in order to comply with mandates and laws passed by some U.S. municipalities that restrict direct trade with Burma.
Kodak declined to comment on when the contract would be discontinued.
Allen said Kodak will continue to sell consumer products thoughout Asia through various independent dealers.
